title: Stop is an attempt on the whole process group and never a rollback

steps.when: the user chooses Stop in the view or the Status Item
steps.then: the state becomes stopping and the Host sends SIGINT to the task's process group, as Control-C in a terminal would; Homebrew defers it during its own clean-up ('One sec, cleaning up...')
if the group remains 10 s later the Host sends SIGTERM, and 5 s after that SIGKILL (grace periods provisional until #88 measures real installs; reads ended within 12 ms of SIGINT)
the result says which signal ended it, and the Host's text says the package may be partly installed or unchanged; nothing is restored

steps.when: Stop names a task that already ended
steps.then: the stop request is refused with task_finished; nothing is signalled
